description: APPROXIMATION, NOT A LITERAL APPROVAL PARK -- read this before trusting the case. 07 section 7.11 names approval-park as a seed case, but the eval harness cannot exercise a real one: runEvalCase() calls dispatch() directly, and approval parking happens in scheduler.ts/approval-gate.ts BEFORE dispatch is ever reached, so no case file can drive a task into awaiting_approval. brain.result.v1's status enum has no awaiting-approval member either, because a parked task has no terminal result to record. What this case actually pins is the nearest real behavior the pipeline does reach: a task that stops before finishing, on a budget abort, ends terminal-but-not-succeeded (timeout) with no verdicts, because a run that never completed has nothing to verify. The genuine approval gate is covered by unit tests over approval-gate.ts and autonomy.ts, not here.

prompt.objective: Perform a change large enough that the task stops before it finishes.

acceptance.statement: When the task finishes, the completed marker file shall exist.
